# U97: The first screen and the way in: Welcome at its own address with one main action; set-up at its own; the invitation opens the workspace it names, says who set it up and asks which one you are; a link to nothing opens nothing; Welcome back remembers

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `SETUP-FIRST-SCREEN`, `IDENTITY`, `ONBOARDING`
- **Budget:** at most 22 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As no one chosen yet, at `/` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U97

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser, with no one chosen yet.
- _Note:_ A browser with nothing: the root leads to Welcome, never into a workspace.
- Go to `/` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/welcome”.
- **Check:** “Run the company on outcomes, and manage by exception” is shown.
- **Check:** (`entry`) met when `primaries.length === 1 && primaries[0].trim() === 'Set up a workspace' && await p.getByRole('link', { name: /^Look around the demo/ }).isVisible() && await p.getByRole('button', { name: /^Join a workspace you were invited to/ }).isVisible()`, where `const primaries = await p.locator('.welcome .btn.primary').allInnerTexts()`. Else it says: Welcome’s main action and doors: {primaries.join(' | ')}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “welcome”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ A pasted link that isn't an invitation is said, under the field.
- **Step.** Press the “Join a workspace you were invited to” button.
- **Step.** Type “https://example.com/goals” into the “The link you were sent” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Open it” button.
- **Check:** (`errors`) an alert showing “That isn’t a Faro invitation.” is visible (else: a link that isn’t an invitation is not explained).
- _Note:_ The link /ready copied before, to a workspace that isn't there, says so too: it doesn't land on Welcome (#285's review).
- Go to `/?workspace=ws_nope` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** “This invitation doesn’t open a workspace” is shown (else: the old link to a workspace that isn’t there did not say so: {p.url()}).
- _Note:_ Set-up has its own address, with nothing open.
- Go to `/workspace/new` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** The “Workspace name” field shows.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/workspace”.
- **Check:** It fails if /workspace/new drew Welcome.
- **Step.** Type “Field Operations” into the “Workspace name” field.
- **Step.** Type “Ana Silva” into the “Your name” field.
- **Step.** Type “Field Ops” into the “Your team” field.
- **Step.** Type “ana.silva@example.com” into the “Your email” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Next: people” button.
- Type “Ben Carter” into the “Person 1: name” field.
- Type “ben.carter@example.com” into the “Person 1: email” field.
- Type “Cara Diaz” into the “Person 2: name” field.
- Type “cara.diaz@example.com” into the “Person 2: email” field.
- Type “Dispatch” into the “Person 2: team” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Next: goals” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Later” choice.
- **Step.** Press the “Next: check” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Create Field Operations” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/ready”.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `() => localStorage.getItem('goals-live-workspace')`.
- **Step.** Press the “Copy the link to send” button.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `link.endsWith('/join/' + encodeURIComponent(wsId))`, where `const wsId = await p.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('goals-live-workspace'))`; `const link = await p.evaluate(() => navigator.clipboard.readText()).catch(() => '')`. Else it says: the invitation is not /join/<workspace>: {link}.
- _Note:_ A teammate on another device, with this browser's store but no one chosen: the link opens the arrival.
- Go to `/join/{encodeURIComponent(wsId)}` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** “Welcome to Field Operations” is shown (else: the invitation does not open the workspace it names).
- **Check:** “Ana Silva set this up on” is shown (else: the arrival does not say who set it up).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `rows.length === 3 && rows.some((r) => /Ana Silva[\s\S]*Set this up · admin/.test(r)) && rows.some((r) => /Ben Carter[\s\S]*No goals yet/.test(r)) && await q.getByText('Not on the list?').isVisible()`, where `const rows = await q.locator('.arrival-person').allInnerTexts()`. Else it says: the arrival’s people: {worked out in the journey as `rows.map((r) => r.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')).join(' | ')`}.
- **Check:** It fails if the arrival shows the workspace’s shell before anyone is chosen.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “arrival”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The arrival has a way out, and setting up a workspace of your own isn't held at it (#285's review, medium 1).
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Go to Welcome” link is visible (else: the arrival has no way to Welcome).
- Go to `/workspace/new` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** The “Workspace name” field shows.
- Go to `/join/{encodeURIComponent(wsId)}` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** “Welcome to Field Operations” is shown (else: the invitation did not open again after set-up was left).
- **Step.** Press the “Ben Carter” button.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** The getting started (`section.getting-started`) shows.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `(w) => (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('goals-live-v1:' + w) || '{"changes":[]}').changes || []).filter((c) => c.entity === 'person' && c.action === 'acknowledged').map((c) => c.summary)`, given `wsId`, where `const wsId = await p.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('goals-live-workspace'))`.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `log.length === 1 && log[0] === 'Ben Carter opened Field Operations for the first time'`, where `const wsId = await p.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('goals-live-workspace'))`; `const log = await q.evaluate((w) => (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('goals-live-v1:' + w) || '{"changes":[]}').changes || []).filter((c) => c.entity === 'person' && c.action === 'acknowledged').map((c) => c.summary), wsId)`. Else it says: the arrival is not logged once: {JSON.stringify(log)}.
- _Note:_ A link to a workspace that isn't there opens nothing else.
- Go to `/join/ws_nope` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** “This invitation doesn’t open a workspace” is shown (else: a link to nothing is not said).
- **Check:** It fails if a link to nothing opened a workspace.
- _Note:_ The old link leads to the invitation's address; someone known there lands on Home.
- Go to `/?workspace={encodeURIComponent(wsId)}` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** The getting started, or the page’s heading area (`section.getting-started, .page-head`) shows.
- _Note:_ Welcome back: what this device remembers, with Open.
- Go to `/welcome` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** “Welcome back” is shown (else: Welcome does not greet someone returning).
- **Check:** “You’re Ben Carter here” is shown (else: Welcome back does not say who you are in the workspace).
- **Check:** (`progress`) the “Open Field Operations” button is visible (else: Welcome back has no Open for the workspace).
- **Step.** Press the “Open Field Operations” button.
- **Check:** The getting started, or the page’s heading area (`section.getting-started, .page-head`) shows.
- Close this browser.
